Introduction

Arrays and Vectors

C++ offers different containers to store elements of the same type in an ordered way. Arrays have a fixed size while vectors can grow dynamically.

You can check containers for emptiness with the member function empty and use size to find the number of elements.

Instructions

You are a teaching assistant correcting student exams. Keeping track of results manually is tedious and prone to mistakes.

1. Rounding Scores

Create the round down scores function that takes a vector of student scores and returns a new vector containing integer scores.

  • Keep every student score in its original order.
round_down_scores({90.33, 40.5});
